div.p: A better trip starts with knowing what the data can—and cannot—tell you.
Later-day median minus the first-30-minute median. A larger positive difference is a reason to investigate a ride early—not guaranteed time saved.
Recommendations normally require three distinct days. Opening comparisons also require six early and twelve later open snapshots. One-day mode is exploratory.
Median is the middle posted wait. P95 is a longer-wait scenario within the observed sample. Neither measures your actual time in line.

div.h2: What counts as a complete day?
div.p: Hours are inferred from attractions observed both open and closed that day. We require observations before and after the inferred boundaries, a finished local day and at least two operating hours. Always-open shows cannot define the boundaries. Days require at least 90% estimated polling coverage and no excessive internal gap. Overnight operations are split at midnight.

Weather, scheduled closures and maintenance can all appear unavailable. Completed episodes require open observations on both sides. Gaps greater than two expected polling intervals plus one minute and incomplete episodes are not included in typical outage durations.

Choose your must-dos, check ride eligibility, confirm official schedules and leave time for food and travel. This app has no reservation inventory, walking-time model or December crowd forecast. No historical samples are fabricated.

div.span: Posted waits. Observed patterns. Your decisions.
